gl:definition.gl:content: digital record of product characteristics throughout its life cycle that is accessible via electronic means through a data carrier

gl:notes.gl:content: Example characteristics include environmental sustainability, environmental impact, and recyclability.

Harmonization note (UniDPP): EN 18219:2026 and EN 18220:2026 extend the definition by accessibility through a data carrier; the shorter formulation shared by EN 18216:2026, EN 18221:2026, EN 18222:2026, EN 18223:2026, EN 18239 and EN 18246 is recorded under concept dpp-0001, where the definitional conflict with ISO/AWI 25534-1 is also annotated.
